title: Projects

content: Hello there! I’m Sam, a CFX TD with an interest in making character effects tools that are clean and easy to use. In my senior year at Brigham Young University, I am making an animated short with 40 of my peers. With my team, we are solving the film’s character simulation needs. Since 2016, I have been pursuing technical work within the animation industry. In high school, I spent my free time experimenting with 3D modeling and coding. Upon the release of Disney’s Zootopia, I was inspired to apply my 3D and technical passion to film. Motivated by the movie’s fur simulation technology, I found my way to Brigham Young University’s animation program to study character FX. At BYU, I worked with the school’s animation IT infrastructure. In 2025, I interned with the Pixar IT systems team. In both jobs I worked with artists from every specialty, removing their technical roadblocks in hardware and software. When I’m not running sims in Houdini or coding in Vim, I can be found drawing, cooking, or exploring the mountains.
